The four files in retained357/ are unchanged byte copies of the corresponding
verification/tool_graders_rna_structure_producer_2026-10-26_357/check003/examples/
packets. They retain earlier native ViennaRNA 2.7.0 results, original software
identities, model settings and failure records. Copying/recalculating them is
not a new native execution and does not authenticate a new episode handoff.

prediction.json and evaluation.json contain original populated sheets. The two
other packets retain original native record dictionaries; tests reserialize
those dictionaries solely as supplied parser inputs. That encoding has its own
digest and does not claim byte identity to the original native artifact.

All other energies created by verification/367 fixture_helpers.py and the test
modules are explicitly invented arithmetic fixtures. Their software-pin values
simulate supplied profile inputs; they do not authenticate scientific work.
